Illustrative interface

Online meetings, without a bot.

ZoomGoogle Meet

Mac audio capture has been exercised with Zoom and Google Meet. Audio capture, call detection and automatic mute observation have separate compatibility limits. Use Pichi’s microphone control for direct control over local recording.

Russian conferencing compatibility

Yandex Telemost, Kontur.Talk, MTS Link, VK Teams and TrueConf have been examined. End-to-end recording and mute handling in Pichi Voice are still being verified. Client support and permissions vary; these are not fully validated integrations.

Local by choice

Your conversations.
Your control.

Choose where processing happens before you record.

Review capture, audio retention and sharing settings. Record only conversations you are authorized to process.

On-device processing

Compatible local models process audio on your device after the necessary files are downloaded. Core local recording and transcription do not require a Pichi account.

Ready before you go offline

Model downloads and first-use setup need an internet connection. Finish them before an offline meeting and try a short recording on your device.

Cloud features are optional

Selecting a cloud provider or an upload feature can send relevant content to that service. Exported files follow the receiving app’s or storage service’s controls.

FAQ

A few useful
answers.

Does it work offline?

Local recording and compatible on-device transcription work after model setup. Download the necessary files while online. Cloud providers and account features require a connection.

Do I need a Pichi account?

Core local recording and transcription work without an account. Account and upload features are optional.

Can my phone record a Zoom or phone call?

The mobile workflow records the device microphone for conversations around it. It does not capture another iOS application’s call audio. Use Mac for computer-audio recording.

Does conference mute always stop local recording?

Automatic observation depends on the client and permissions and can have a delay. Pichi Voice has a separate microphone control for local capture. Check it when you need direct control.

Are transcripts and speaker labels always correct?

Recognition, speaker labels and generated summaries may contain mistakes. Review important wording and participant names before relying on or sharing the result.
